description.value: Paliotti's Abbotsford is the flagship location of a three-generation, family-owned Italian restaurant group with roots stretching back to 1960s Montreal. The restaurant is described as the largest and most vibrant of the family's locations, featuring comfortable booths, outdoor seating, a private upstairs dining area, and a full-service bar with cocktails, beer, and wine. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down Italian meal on Essendene Avenue in downtown Abbotsford, with takeout also available through major delivery platforms.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 50m; wave (2 spaces) at 60m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating restaurant at 33886 Essendene Ave, Abbotsford with phone 604-855-1888, matching OSM. Takeout is explicitly confirmed on the website ('Paliottis Abbotsford Take-out Orders', Skip-the-Dishes, DoorDash links). OSM tags indicate free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) and outdoor seating, but the website does not independently confirm Wi-Fi so that remains null per rules; outdoor seating is mentioned on the website ('outdoor seating') so that corroborates OSM. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website.
concerns: The contact page lists a third Chilliwack location (604-402-1202, 45850 Yale Rd Unit 500B, Chilliwack BC V2P 2N9) that does not appear to have its own OSM record — may be worth adding separately if confirmed open.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible Italian restaurant confirmed by website content with matching address and phone. A solid meal stop for touring cyclists in Abbotsford.
